_comment: The three targets asked for, and only those. Same schema and the same type IDs as calc/devices.json and socal-calc/devices.json (TI link protocol guide / tilibs: TI-83+ PRGM 0x05 ASM 0x06; TI-89/92 ASM 0x21). The variable names differ from SITEK and SOCAL so all three ports can live on one calculator at the same time.

devices.name: TI-83 / TI-83+ / TI-84+
devices.prefix_note: BB 6D = AsmPrgm token; required for a TI-83+/84+ program to run as machine code.
devices.note: Tightest target: 96x64 and a 24 KB practical program budget. 70 point features across 96 px is a smudge at zoom 1, so it opens one step in, like the SOCAL port.

devices.name: TI-89 / TI-89 Titanium
devices.prefix_note: Payload must be a linked AMS program (TIGCC/GCC4TI or a68k+mlink); this packer only writes the container.
devices.note: 160x100 fits the whole quadripoint frame at zoom 1 and the full dossier with two story lines.

devices.name: TI-92 / TI-92 Plus
devices.prefix_note: Payload must be a linked AMS program from TIGCC/GCC4TI.
devices.note: Largest LCD in the family: 240x128, 30 bytes per row, 3840-byte framebuffer. The only target that shows all eight layer rows and the full dossier at once.
